summary: SELLAS Life Sciences Group filed a Form 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) disclosing updated cash position and share count. As of March 31, 2026, the company had $107.1 million in cash. In April and May 2026, it received approximately $28.7 million from warrant exercises. As of June 2, 2026, outstanding shares totaled 196,632,574. This is a routine update on capital structure and liquidity. No transaction, strategic review, board change, or special event is described. The filing is purely informational and does not trigger any special-situation category.
